description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for different models across various categories, with the horizontal axis displaying categories labeled as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, and the vertical axis representing the 'Shapley value' on a linear scale from 0 to 80, with tick intervals of 20 units. Bars are grouped by category, with each group containing three bars corresponding to the models mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (green). The tallest bars occur in category T, where mBERT reaches approximately 50, XLM-R reaches about 55, and chLSTM attains the maximum value of 80. In all other categories—L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺—the Shapley values are relatively low, generally below 15. Notably, for both L₁ and R₁, the values for R₁ are consistently higher than those for L₁ across all models, suggesting a stronger contribution from the right context. The legend in the top right corner identifies the model-color associations.
